title: Named product-open tensor and projection composites
statement: Fix a finite commutative coefficient ring A and the ordinary unbounded pro-etale A-module derived categories. For two maps a:Xbar to B and b:Zbar to B and two opens j:X to Xbar and k:Z to Zbar, retain exactly the named products, tensor and pullback comparisons of [lem-pur-finite-open-product-swap] and proper/open mate of [lem-sf-proper-open-tensor-compatibility]. Define projection and exchange by the ordinary counit-defined maps transported by the canonical exact/left-derived comparison, openUnit by the fully faithful open adjunction unit, and the objects H,J,D,F,K,KD,m,L0 and all maps e,betaI,chi,A0,B0,d,iTensorSecond,w,nu,eta,delta,Gamma,s,GammaD,projectionTail,Psi,T,restrictNu,restrictEta,mSupport,restrictW exactly as in the displayed definitions formerly in lem-pur-product-open-tensor-projection. These definitions and their types and bodies are unchanged; the shared module makes the independent normalization steps importable without a cycle.

source.place: Symmetry paragraph, proper reduction; explicit proof Steps 1--5 of lem-pur-product-open-tensor-projection.

mathlib_searches.query: The tensor of an open adjunction counit with an object extended by zero is an isomorphism and restricts to the identity.
mathlib_searches.results: Adjunction.counitAsIsoOfIso and isIso_counit_of_iso (Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monad.Adjunction) concern an equivalence, not tensor-supported objects. Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId concerns ordinary scheme modules. None states the finite pro-etale derived comparisons.

mathlib_searches.query: Open tensor product comparison on two product open immersions agrees with tensoring the open counit and restricts to the open unit.
mathlib_searches.results: Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp and restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app concern ordinary scheme module restriction. Scheme.Pullback.tensorCongr_SpecTensorTo concerns affine scheme products, not derived open extension. No matching map identity.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib Monoidal/Functor map_mu_comp_counit_app_tensor needs monoidal structures on the named functors. Existing source ProjectionMap supplies adjunct and invertibility APIs; ProperOpenProjectionMate supplies the derived-coordinate equation. The exact-pullback transport and the supported product restriction identities are not already stated. The only blueprint supported-product hit is the relative Kunneth unit, whose symmetry paragraph is the source here.
